    echo

{"command":"create","path":"/workspace/purge_unowned_etc.sh","file_text":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Backup and delete unowned (non-package) files under /etc, with safe exclusions
set -euo pipefail
TS=$(date +%F_%H%M%S)
WORKDIR=${1:-/workspace/audit}
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
BACKUP_DIR="$WORKDIR/etc_backup_$TS"
PLAN="$WORKDIR/delete_plan_$TS.txt"
LOG="$WORKDIR/delete_run_$TS.log"
UNOWNED=$(mktemp)
FILTERED=$(mktemp)
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

# 1) Build unowned list (exclude heavy generated dirs early)
find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type l \) \
  ! -path '/etc/ssl/*' \
  ! -path '/etc/pki/*' \
  ! -path '/etc/systemd/*' \
  ! -path '/etc/alternatives/*' \
  -print \
| while IFS= read -r f; do dpkg -S "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "$f"; done > "$UNOWNED"

# 2) Exclude critical/generated/essential files
GREP_EXCLUDES='^/etc/(hostname|hosts|resolv\.conf|timezone|localtime|ld\.so\.cache|\.pwd\.lock|subuid|subgid|environment|shells)$|^/etc/(group-|gshadow-|passwd-|shadow-)$'
grep -Ev "$GREP_EXCLUDES" "$UNOWNED" | sort -u > "$FILTERED" || true
COUNT=$(wc -l < "$FILTERED" | tr -d ' ')

{
  echo "=== Deletion plan generated at $TS ==="
  echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
  echo "Candidates (unowned, after exclusions): $COUNT"
  echo
  cat "$FILTERED"
} > "$PLAN"

# 3) Backup and delete
if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "Backing up and deleting $COUNT candidate files..." | tee -a "$LOG"
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    dest="$BACKUP_DIR$f"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
    cp -a "$f" "$dest" 2>/dev/null || cp -a --no-preserve=ownership,mode,timestamps "$f" "$dest" || true
    rm -f -- "$f"
    echo "deleted: $f" >> "$LOG"
  done < "$FILTERED"
else
